result.notes: Freshdesk v2 REST API uses HTTP Basic Auth with the API key as username (no password needed); no OAuth2 for the core API. API key is available immediately in Profile Settings for any account, including the 14-day free trial, but there is no permanent free tier — sustained use requires a paid plan (Growth/Pro/Enterprise). Wide resource coverage (tickets, contacts, companies, agents, solutions, automations, CSAT, custom objects, etc.); Composio catalogs 178 tools, suggesting medium API breadth. No vendor-published MCP server found; only community implementations (effytech/freshdesk_mcp and others) exist.
result.one_liner: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support/helpdesk platform (ticketing, omnichannel, automations) by Freshworks.
